correctness.rationale: Independent uncolored cells are a partial permutation. Exactly two colored intermediates serve each pair of uncolored cells, forcing a proper coloring of the doubled complete graph; all other neighbors occur in just one uncolored neighborhood, making the condition sufficient. The doubled clique edge-chromatic indices follow from matching-size lower bounds and exact one-factorization/near-factorization constructions. The parity and rectangular gap threshold, all coefficients and minimum values then follow for all 2<=m<=n; code checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Provides a natural complete infinite-family classification and all-support enumerator for the same novel singleton rainbow parameter, not just an easy numerical bound. The overfull doubled-clique obstruction creates a sharp parity/aspect-ratio regime where generic alpha-based lower bounds fail, with explicit constructive realizability in every other case. It can guide larger neighborhood-conflict studies, while remaining a self-contained valuable exact result.
